How It Works

The pulsing dot on each overlay is a local CSS animation. It proves that overlay’s page is still rendering in OBS. It is not sent to Pulse, and this dashboard does not watch, score, or recover anything. Central heartbeat monitoring is on the roadmap; until then this page stays empty instead of inventing a healthy control room.
